client.business_model: Multi-site women's health medical group offering OB-GYN, primary care and virtual care through a network of clinics and telehealth platforms
client.client_history: Founded in 2014 by Sean Glass, Advantia Health has expanded through acquisitions such as the 2019 purchase of Heartland Women’s Healthcare and investments from Deerfield Management and BlueMountain Capital to build a technology-enabled, multi-state women’s health platform.

revenue.notes: Public estimates vary widely: Zippia USD 13 M, Growjo USD 22.4 M, Buzzfile USD 29.1 M, CanvasBusinessModel USD 89 M. No official figure found; used mid-range of the two more credible business-data sites (Growjo/Buzzfile), reporting with low confidence.

locations.source: Company website locations list (22 sites across DC, MD, VA, IL, MO) plus PR Newswire release stating Heartland acquisition added 25 locations (2019)
locations.notes: Website currently lists 22 operational sites; Heartland acquisition announcement referenced 25 additional clinics. Some overlap likely; approximate total around 40, but no single authoritative count available.

employees.source: LeadIQ company profile (501 employees, Dec 2025) and Indeed company page (501-1,000 range)
employees.notes: Employee estimates cluster around the 500–1,000 range. LeadIQ gives the most specific figure (501); averaged with upper-range signals to report 600 with medium confidence.
